Fear Factory catch hate from a lot of (most?) "metal heads" for being mainstream nu-metal posers, but I, personally, don't think the all of the hate is justified. I think their first album is pretty good, and their second is alright. They were doing something a little different at the time (early '90s), mixing industrial, death/grind, groove metal. and pop. I honestly think they should get a bit more credit for experimenting. Music needs experimentation/change, or it just gets stale/tedious. They did get more and more nu-metal/pop/mainstream oriented with each album though, and I can't say I really dig any of their work after their first couple of albums. But don't let the Fear Factory haters deter you from digging them.

But that's just my opinion, and I'm pretty open, musically. I try to like/appreciate all forms of music, even if some of it makes me want to projectile vomit, and gouge out my ear drums.
